name: agent-bridge-solo
description: Tier-P F1 solo scenario: install ONLY agent-bridge (the without-agent-worktrees degenerate case) and assert the DEGRADE-SAFE contract -- agent-bridge is loose-coupled to agent-worktrees (no hard import; reads AW data files + shells binstubs when present, falls open when absent), so installed alone it must still provision, expose a binstub with a real version, and answer its read verbs (agents/machines/sessions/status) rather than crash on a missing base. Name-free / public.

stages.title: binstub on PATH + reports a REAL version
DEGRADE-SAFE: read verbs answer without an agent-worktrees base
